# Binly kit — API reference (generated by tools/kitdoc.mjs from docs/kit/*.md)
Import from `../../../kit/<module>` inside a chapter. Visual showcase: `node tools/still.mjs --comp Gallery --props "{\"page\":\"<page>\"}" --at 4` (pages: text cards diagrams data icons env science geo people transitions).

## Core — stage, camera, time, shots (`kit/stage`, `kit/anim`, `kit/shots`, `kit/theme`)

**theme** — `C` palette (paper, paperLight/Shade/Deep/Dark, ink, inkSoft/Lift/Mute/Faint, oxblood, oxLight/oxTint/oxDeep,
evidence(+Light/Tint), theory(+Light/Tint), caution(+Light/Tint), bone, wood/woodDark/woodLight, stone/stoneShade/stoneDark,
metal, lamp, fire, water/waterDeep, slate, sky, dusk, night, skin[0..4], skinShade[0..4], hair[0..4], strata[0..6]),
`SEM` (confirmed|evidence|theory|speculation|caution|debated|signal|ink → colour), `FONT_SERIF`, `FONT_SANS`, `W`=1920, `H`=1080, `SAFE`=96.

**anim** (pure functions of t):
- `ramp(t,a,b,fn=ease.inOut)` 0→1 · `unramp` 1→0 · `keys(t,[[t,v],…],fn)` · `win(t,a,b,fi=.4,fo=.4)` fade window
- `stagger(t,start,i,gap,dur,fn)` · `drift(t,period,amp,phase)` · `noise1(x,seed)` ∈[-1,1] · `rand(seed)` ∈[0,1) · `randRange(seed,lo,hi)`
- `ease.{linear,inOut,out,in,outQuint,inOutQuint,inOutSine,outSine,outBack,outElastic}` · `lerp` · `clamp01` · `mixHex(a,b,k)`
- `camAt(t, [[time,cx,cy,zoom,rotDeg?],…])` → CamState (log-space zoom) · `typeOn(t,a,text,cps)` · `countUp(value,p)` (exact landing)

**stage**
- `<Stage bg={C.paper}>…svg children…</Stage>` full 1920×1080 frame (every shot/chapter renders one).
- `<Cam cam={state} depth={1}>` camera group (depth<1 far/slow, >1 foreground). `<CamKeys t keys={[...]} depth>` shorthand.
- `<World cam={cam} layers={[{depth:0.3, el:<Far/>},{depth:1, el:<Main/>},{depth:1.4, el:<Front/>}]}/>` parallax.
- `breathe(cam,t,amount=1)` subtle handheld life for holds · `shake(cam,t,t0,strength=14,decay=5)` impacts.
- `<At x y s sx sy r o>` transform wrapper · `uid(...parts)` stable ids for clip paths.

**shots**
- `<Shots t shots={[{start, render:(t)=>el, in?:{kind,dur?,x?,y?,dir?,color?}}]}/>` sequence with transitions.
  kinds: `cut fade dip ink iris irisOut push paper zoom wipe` (x,y = focus point; dir = left|right|up|down).
- `<TransitionView tr p a b/>` low-level blend of two elements.

**video** — `ChapterDef {id,start,end,C,in?}` · `<Chapters t chapters/>` (generated `index.tsx` uses it).

## Text (`kit/text`) — p = reveal progress 0→1
- `Headline {x,y,text,p,size=72,color,anchor='middle',italic,weight=600,mode:'rise'|'words'|'type'|'mask',accent?:{word:colour},font:'serif'|'sans',out?}`
  e.g. `<Headline x={960} y={220} text="A hot bath was medicine." mode="words" accent={{medicine: C.oxblood}} p={ramp(t,T.a,T.a+1)}/>`
- `Kicker {x,y,text,p=1,size=24,color=inkMute,anchor}` small tracked caps label.
- `Para {x,y,w,h=600,text,p,size=36,color,align,font,weight,italic,lineHeight}` wrapped paragraph (keep short).
- `Tag {x,y,text,kind:Sem,p,size=26,to?:{x,y},anchor:'left'|'right'|'center',dot}` semantic chip, optional leader line.
- `Stamp {x,y,text,p,color=oxblood,size=56,rot=-6}` thumping verdict stamp.
- `Stat {x,y,value:'0.061',unit?:'%',label?,p,count=true,size=180,color,anchor}` exact number, counts up, lands exactly.
- `Underline {x,y,w,p,color,thick,wobble}` · `Highlight {x,y,w,h,p,color,opacity}` (draw BEFORE text) · `Circled {x,y,rx,ry?,p,color,thick,rot}`
- `NameTag {x,y,name,sub?,p,anchor:'left'|'right',color,dark}` real person / source label.
- `TitleCard {x,y,kicker?,title,p,out?,color,kickerColor,size=96}` chapter/section title.
- `textW(text,size,font,weight)` approximate width for layout.

## Cards & paper objects (`kit/cards`) — origin centre, p = entrance (rise+settle)
- `Card {x,y,w,h,p,rot,fill,stroke,radius,shadow,children}` children in card-local coords (0,0 top-left).
- `DocumentPage {x,y,s,p,rot,title?,subtitle?,lines=11,text?,highlight?:{line,p,color},seal,sealColor,signature,style:'parchment'|'modern'|'journal',write}` ≈560×740.
- `Polaroid {id,x,y,w=460,p,rot,imageBg,caption,children}` children inside square window (centre 0,0).
- `StudyCard {x,y,p,rot,title,who?,year?,finding?,n?,tag?:{text,kind},accent}` 640×380 research card.
- `Note {x,y,text,p,rot,color,w,h,size}` sticky note · `OpenBook {x,y,s,p,rot,cover,lines,leftTitle,rightTitle}` ≈640×420.
- `Screen {id,x,y,w=760,h=440,p,frame:'monitor'|'tablet'|'phone',bg,children}` children in screen coords (top-left 0,0).
- `ScreenText {x,y,text,p,t,size,color,cursor}` typewriter line for screens.
- `Bubble {x,y,w,h,text?,to?:{x,y},p,kind:'speech'|'thought'|'inner',fill,color,size,type}` — `inner` = dashed plum (silent inner voice).

## Diagrams (`kit/diagrams`) — p = draw-on
- `Arrow {from,to,p,bend=0,color,width=6,head=22,dashed,double,shorten}` (curved if bend≠0).
- `Node {x,y,text,p,w?,h=110,kind:Sem,filled,size,icon?}` labelled box.
- `FlowChain {x,y,items[],p,gap=140,dir:'row'|'column',kinds?:Sem[],size,nodeW}` sequential cause→effect.
- `Cycle {x,y,r,items[],p,spin,kinds,size}` · `Venn {x,y,r,labels[],overlap?,p,kinds,spread}`
- `Bracket {a,b,p,depth,label,color,size}` · `Callout {target,label,text,p,kind,size,anchor}` elbow leader label.
- `DashedOutline {d,p,color=theory,width,fill}` (= absent/inferred) · `CrossOut {x,y,size,p}` · `CheckMark {x,y,size,p}` · `QuestionMark {x,y,size,p,color,t}`

## Effects (`kit/fx`)
- `LightPool {x,y,r,color=lamp,strength,sy}` flat light · `LightShaft {x1,x2,y,dx,len,spread,color,strength}` window beam
- `GroundShadow {x,y,w,h?,o}` · `Vignette {strength,color}` · `Pulse {x,y,r,p,color}` one ring · `Beacon {x,y,r,t,period}` repeating
- `DrawPath {d,p,stroke,width,fill,dash,cap,o}` draw any path on · `Pop {x,y,p,from,r,children}` scale-in · `SlideIn {p,dx,dy,children}`
- `WipeReveal {id,x,y,w,h,p,dir,children}` · `Particles {t,x,y,w,h,n,seed,size,color,opacity,vx,vy,wobble,shape:'dot'|'ring'|'blob',twinkle}`
- `Steam {t,x,y,w,h,n,color,strength}` rising wisps · `Flame {t,x,y,s,seed,glow}` candle/torch · `Ripples {t,x,y,r,n,period,color,sy}`

## People (`kit/people`) — origin = feet, ≈540 px tall at s=1, drawn facing right (`facing=-1` mirrors)
- `Person {x,y,s,facing,t, pose?, arms?:{front:[shoulderDeg,elbowDeg],back:[…]}, walk?:phase(cycles), stride, sit:0..1, lean, look:-1..1, tilt,
  expression:'neutral'|'smile'|'happy'|'worried'|'surprised'|'thinking'|'sad'|'angry'|'determined', talk:0..1, blink?, skin:0..4,
  hair:'short'|'long'|'bun'|'curly'|'bald'|'tonsure'|'side'|'ponytail'|'none', hairColor, beard:'none'|'short'|'full'|'moustache', glasses,
  outfit:'tunic'|'robe'|'dress'|'coat'|'labcoat'|'suit'|'casual'|'royal'|'scrubs'|'nightwear', top,bottom,accent,
  hat:'none'|'coif'|'hood'|'tophat'|'crown'|'cap'|'brimmed'|'scholar'|'veil'|'beret'|'surgical', hatColor, shoes, silhouette?:colour, opacity, seed}`
  poses: idle point wave think shrug present hold write cheer worried armsOut reach handsBack facepalm cross.
  Walk: `walk={t*0.9}` + move x yourself (≈ 150 px/s at s=1). Talk: `talk={Math.abs(Math.sin(t*9))}` while speaking.
  Sitting: `sit={1}` → hips at height ≈118·s above the feet, ≈104·s behind them (place the seat there).
- `personHands(props)` → {front,back,head} world positions (attach held objects).
- `Crowd {x,y,w,n=9,rows=2,t,seed,s=0.6,era:'medieval'|'19thc'|'modern',silhouette?,facing:1|-1|'mixed',expression}`

# data — `src/kit/data.tsx`

Data visualisation for **exact** statistics: every number shown comes from an explicit prop, so the screen
says exactly what the narration says. Numbers in Fraunces 700, labels in Inter caps. All take `p` 0→1
(build-on; settled at 1). Count-ups land exactly on the given string (uses `countUp`). Gallery: `{"page":"data"}`.

Helpers: `fmtNum(12500) → "12,500"`, `fmtYear(-400) → "400 BCE"` (`fmtYear(y, true)` adds " CE").

## BarChart
Vertical bars growing staggered; value labels count up on top, category labels below.
Box (x,y)=top-left, w×h **includes** value + category labels. `highlight` index → oxblood, others muted.
```ts
<BarChart x y w h bars: {label; value; color?; valueLabel?}[]; p; max?; highlight?; color?=C.inkLift;
  highlightColor?=C.oxblood; grid?=true; labelSize?=22 />
```
```tsx
<BarChart x={200} y={200} w={800} h={500} p={ramp(t,1,3)} highlight={0}
  bars={[{label:'Florence', value:60, valueLabel:'60%'}, {label:'Paris', value:50, valueLabel:'50%'}]} />
```
Labels may use `"\n"` for two lines. Keep slot width (w / bars) ≥ label width.

## DotGrid
Waffle / "26 out of 100". Origin = top-left. Empty dots fade in, then filled dots fill **in order**.
```ts
<DotGrid x y cols rows filled?; p; size?=26; gap?=size*0.42; color?=C.oxblood; empty?=C.paperDeep;
  groups?: {count; color}[]; shape?: 'dot'|'square'|'person'; order?: 'row'|'col' />
dotGridSize(cols, rows, size?, gap?) → {w, h}
```
```tsx
<DotGrid x={700} y={250} cols={10} rows={10} filled={26} size={40} p={ramp(t,0.5,4)} />
<DotGrid x={700} y={250} cols={10} rows={10} groups={[{count:26,color:C.oxblood},{count:40,color:C.theory}]} p={p} />
```

## PercentRing
Donut filling to `value` (0–100) while the exact `label` counts up in the centre. Origin = centre.
```ts
<PercentRing x y r?=120 value label p; color?=C.oxblood; track?=C.paperShade; thick?=r*0.2; caption?; labelSize? />
```
```tsx
<PercentRing x={960} y={500} r={180} value={26} label="26%" caption="of waking moments" p={ramp(t,1,3)} />
```

## Comparison
A-vs-B split panel. Box (x,y)=top-left of both panels. Side = `{title; value?; body?; color?; count?}`
(`count:false` for years/IDs). Left slides in, then right, then the VS badge (`vs={null}` hides it).
```ts
<Comparison x y w h left: Side; right: Side; p; vs?='vs'; gap?=36; valueSize?; bodySize?=30 />
```
```tsx
<Comparison x={140} y={300} w={1640} h={420} p={ramp(t,0,2)}
  left={{title:'Miasma theory', value:'1,500', body:'years as the accepted explanation.', color:C.theory}}
  right={{title:'Germ theory', value:'1861', count:false, body:'Pasteur shows microbes cause decay.', color:C.evidence}} />
```
Keep bodies to ≤ 2 lines per panel (h ≈ 270 fits title + value + 2 body lines at the default sizes).

## TimelineAxis
Year axis that draws on, ticks, staggered event pins (above/below, alternating by default), optional moving
`cursor` (year) shown as an oxblood progress line + year pill (tick labels under the pill hide).
Origin = left end of the axis; needs ~110 px above/below for event labels, ~60 px below for ticks/cursor.
```ts
<TimelineAxis x y w from to p; events?: {year; label; above?; color?; stem?=70; yearLabel?}[];
  ticks?: number[] | step; cursor?: year; format?: (y)=>string; color?=C.ink; cursorColor?=C.oxblood;
  labelSize?=28; tickLabels?=true />
```
```tsx
<TimelineAxis x={160} y={600} w={1600} from={-500} to={2000} ticks={500} p={ramp(t,0,3)}
  cursor={keys(t,[[1,-500],[4,1348]])} events={[{year:1348, label:'Black Death', color:C.oxblood, above:true}]} />
// deep time:  format={(y) => `${-y / 1e6} MYA`}  with from={-252e6} to={-66e6}
```
Default format: negative → "400 BCE"; if the range crosses 0 positives get " CE". Use different `stem`
lengths for neighbouring events on the same side so labels don't collide.

## LineChart
Straight-segment line drawing on left→right with a flat area under it and a leading dot.
Box (x,y,w,h) = **plot area**; y-tick labels sit ~70 px left, x-ticks ~40 px below, `xLabel` ~80 px below,
`yLabel` above the top-left corner. `highlight` point (index or `{index,label}`) pops when the line reaches it.
```ts
<LineChart x y w h points: [x, y][]; p; xLabel?; yLabel?; highlight?: number | {index; label?};
  xDomain?; yDomain?; xTicks?; yTicks?; fmtX?=String; fmtY?=fmtNum; color?=C.oxblood; area?=true />
```
```tsx
<LineChart x={300} y={250} w={1300} h={550} p={ramp(t,0.5,4)} yDomain={[0,100]} yTicks={[0,50,100]}
  points={[[1340,75],[1351,50],[1400,40]]} fmtY={(v)=>`${v}M`} highlight={{index:1, label:'50M'}} yLabel="Europe population" />
```

## Meter
Horizontal certainty bar. Origin = left end of the track centre line. Marker + `valueLabel` above,
end `labels` below, optional `title` higher up. `zones` tints the track in equal bands.
```ts
<Meter x y w value: 0..1; labels: [left, right]; p; color?=C.oxblood; title?; valueLabel?; zones?: string[]; thick?=22 />
```
```tsx
<Meter x={560} y={600} w={800} value={0.35} labels={['Speculation','Confirmed']} valueLabel="Debated" color={C.caution} p={p} />
```

## Gauge
Semicircular dial with needle (gentle overshoot). Origin = needle pivot. `valueLabel` under the pivot.
```ts
<Gauge x y r?=150 value: 0..1; labels: [left, right]; p; color?=C.oxblood; valueLabel?; zones?: string[]; thick?=r*0.17 />
```
```tsx
<Gauge x={960} y={640} r={260} value={0.72} labels={['Guess','Proven']} valueLabel="Likely"
  zones={[C.theoryTint, C.cautionTint, C.evidenceTint]} color={C.evidence} p={ramp(t,0.5,2.5)} />
```

## BalanceScale
"Weighing two theories". Origin = beam pivot; at s=1 beam 460 px wide, stand down to y+330.
`tilt` −1…1 (**animate it yourself**; +1 = right pan down). Items: a number (stack of weight blocks in the
side colour) or any SVG node drawn at the pan rim centre. Labels stay true-size at any `s`.
```ts
<BalanceScale x y tilt; leftLabel?; rightLabel?; leftItems?: number | ReactNode; rightItems?;
  leftColor?=C.theory; rightColor?=C.evidence; color?=C.ink; s?=1; p?=1; labelSize?=22 />
```
```tsx
<BalanceScale x={960} y={380} tilt={keys(t,[[1,0],[2,-0.6],[3.5,0.8]])} leftLabel="Miasma" rightLabel="Germs"
  leftItems={2} rightItems={5} />
```

## CounterRow
Row of exact figures counting up in turn, separated by thin rules, caps labels below.
Origin = left end of the row at the numbers' baseline; total width w.
```ts
<CounterRow x y w items: {value; label; color?; count?}[]; p; size?=88 />
```
```tsx
<CounterRow x={260} y={600} w={1400} p={ramp(t,0,3)}
  items={[{value:'1347', label:'Arrives', count:false}, {value:'25M', label:'Dead', color:C.oxblood}]} />
```

# icons — `src/kit/icons.tsx`

Bold flat pictogram family (filled geometric shapes + 6px round-capped strokes), two-tone: main `color`
plus one `accent` detail. Gallery: `{"page":"icons"}`.

## Icon
One pictogram. Origin = centre; 96×96 px at `s=1` (content within ±44 px). `p` 0→1 pops it in
(scale + slight turn, gentle settle); `p` defaults to 1 (static).

```ts
<Icon name: IconName; x; y; s?=1; color?=C.ink; accent?=C.oxblood; knock?=C.paper; p?=1; r?=0 />
```
- `knock` paints cut-outs (holes, highlights, separators). **Set it to the background colour** when the
  icon is not on plain paper (e.g. `knock={C.ink}` on a dark panel, with `color={C.paperLight}`).
- Semantic use: `color={C.evidence}` on `check`, `color={C.caution}` on `warning`, etc.

```tsx
<Icon name="lungs" x={960} y={540} s={2} p={ramp(t, 1, 1.6)} />
<Icon name="check" x={300} y={200} color={C.evidence} />
<Icon name="moon" x={1600} y={160} color={C.paperLight} accent={C.lamp} knock={C.night} />
```

## ICON_NAMES
`IconName[]` — every available name (64):

question, exclamation, check, cross, warning, info, eye, brain, ear, mouth, hand, heart, lungs, drop, flame,
thermometer, sun, moon, star, cloud, wind, lightning, clock, hourglass, calendar, book, scroll, document,
quill, magnifier, microscope, flask, pill, syringe, germ, virus, dna, atom, person, people, crown, skull,
house, building, church, castle, globe, pin, key, lock, phone, computer, chip, speech, thought, lightbulb,
coin, scale, shield, chart, gear, arrow-right, arrow-up, bath.

Notes: `check/cross/question/exclamation/info` are badge discs (glyph knocked out); `heart`, `flame`,
`lightning`, `pin` are drawn mainly in `accent`. For other arrow directions use `r` (e.g. `arrow-right` with `r={90}`).
